why: PROJECT_SPEC.md §13.7. The ratchet floor, not a target, and CI's number rather than any local one: a mutant that survives on a fast machine can time out on a slow one, and a timeout counts as a detection, so the score is stable on one machine and not across machines. scripts/mutation.sh enforces this only when CI=true. Moving off it in either direction fails — down means coverage eroded, up means this file is stale and the next erosion would be measured from the wrong place. Lowering it needs an argued exception recorded in §13.7.
